blocks.source: Vol III, KV Cache Management, § The Footprint of Retained Attention State
blocks.md: The r18 request's 32,768 tokens do not reach the accelerator as raw text. During causal self-attention in a Transformer decoder, each newly generated token attends to earlier tokens through their key and value projections. Recomputing these projections at every decode step would repeat the linear transformations over the entire historical prefix, creating an unsustainable quadratic compute bottleneck. Serving engines avoid this recomputation by retaining the computed key and value tensors in accelerator memory across decode cycles.

points: **Retained KV state**: Cached attention keys and values are derived execution state for a particular model and token prefix, occupying physical serving memory.
